verses.text: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
lines: “However, Job, please hear my speech,
and listen to all my words.

verses.text: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
lines: See now, I have opened my mouth.
My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

verses.text: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
lines: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart.
That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

verses.text: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
lines: The Spirit of God has made me,
and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

verses.text: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
lines: If you can, answer me.
Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

verses.text: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
lines: Behold, I am toward God even as you are.
I am also formed out of the clay.

verses.text: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
lines: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid,
neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

verses.text: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
lines: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing,
I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

verses.text: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
lines: ‘I am clean, without disobedience.
I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

verses.text: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
lines: Behold, he finds occasions against me.
He counts me for his enemy.

verses.text: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
lines: He puts my feet in the stocks.
He marks all my paths.’

verses.text: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
lines: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just,
for God is greater than man.

verses.text: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
lines: Why do you strive against him,
because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

verses.text: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
lines: For God speaks once,
yes twice, though man pays no attention.

verses.text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;
lines: In a dream, in a vision of the night,
when deep sleep falls on men,
in slumbering on the bed;

verses.text: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
lines: Then he opens the ears of men,
and seals their instruction,

verses.text: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
lines: that he may withdraw man from his purpose,
and hide pride from man.

verses.text: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
lines: He keeps back his soul from the pit,
and his life from perishing by the sword.

verses.text: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
lines: He is chastened also with pain on his bed,
with continual strife in his bones,

verses.text: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
lines: so that his life abhors bread,
and his soul dainty food.

verses.text: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
lines: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen.
His bones that were not seen stick out.

verses.text: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
lines: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit,
and his life to the destroyers.

verses.text: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
lines: “If there is beside him an angel,
an interpreter, one among a thousand,
to show to man what is right for him;

verses.text: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
lines: then God is gracious to him, and says,
‘Deliver him from going down to the pit,
I have found a ransom.’

verses.text: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
lines: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s.
He returns to the days of his youth.

verses.text: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
lines: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him,
so that he sees his face with joy.
He restores to man his righteousness.

verses.text: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
lines: He sings before men, and says,
‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right,
and it didn’t profit me.

verses.text: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
lines: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit.
My life will see the light.’

verses.text: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
lines: “Behold, God does all these things,
twice, yes three times, with a man,

verses.text: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
lines: to bring back his soul from the pit,
that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

verses.text: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
lines: Mark well, Job, and listen to me.
Hold your peace, and I will speak.

verses.text: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
lines: If you have anything to say, answer me.
Speak, for I desire to justify you.

verses.text: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
lines: If not, listen to me.
Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
